components.name: funding-history
components.summary: Assemble a named investigator's federal research support from NIH RePORTER and NSF Award Search, in the shape a current-and-pending support section needs: each award with its number, title, sponsor, dates, total, the person's role and a source link, and a plain statement of what was not found.
triggers: what has this PI been funded for
